reuse.why: Reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and month helpers, but the weekend decision (daily schedules skip, others adjust when skipWeekend) is rewritten inline instead of being drawn from one shared definition alongside getNextDate/getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The handler copies getUpcomingDates' scaffolding (rules, RSchedule, try/captureBreadcrumb) and its skipWeekend ternary, and restates getNextDate's daily-weekend-skip condition, giving a third copy of the weekend rule.

placement.why: Lives next to getUpcomingDates as a schedules app handler, which is where this tree registers such handlers; the weekend rule itself arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its type registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and small, but a future change to weekend handling has to be made in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template and now here.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the actual shift; no full weekend-handling abstraction existed to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated getUpcomingDates structure and daily-skip condition in getDatesInRange (app.ts) are recognisable copies, not reshaped.
